') center/cover no-repeat;filter:blur(34px) brightness(.65) saturate(.8);transform:scale(1.12);opacity:.95}
.album-photo__button{position:absolute;inset:0 0 72px;width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;cursor:zoom-in}.album-photo__button img{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.album-photo__footer{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;min-height:72px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;background:rgba(24,9,15,.82);color:white;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.album-photo__footer span{font-size:10px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.10em;color:#f0b2c1}.album-photo__footer p{margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:14px;line-height:1.35;opacity:.90}
.album-nav{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.84);color:var(--wine);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(78,26,43,.08);transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease}.album-nav:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#fff}
.album-thumbs{display:flex;gap:9px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;max-width:850px;margin:16px auto 0;padding:4px 2px 8px;scroll-snap-type:x proximity}.album-thumbs::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.album-thumb{flex:0 0 58px;width:58px;height:58px;padding:3px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:16px;background:transparent;opacity:.52;cursor:pointer;scroll-snap-align:center;transition:.2s}.album-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;display:block}.album-thumb.active{opacity:1;border-color:var(--wine);background:white;transform:translateY(-2px)}

.scene--words{background:var(--paper)}
.word-constellation{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:42px}
.word-constellation__message{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:128px;padding:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:28px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,var(--paper-2));box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(65,22,37,.06)}
.word-constellation__message span{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;color:var(--wine)}.word-constellation__message p{margin:0;max-width:450px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;line-height:1.45;text-align:center;color:#5d414a}
.word-constellation>button{min-height:82px;padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;background:#fff;color:var(--wine);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease}.word-constellation>button:hover,.word-constellation>button.active{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:rgba(118,29,52,.35);background:#fff8f8}

.scene--music{background:var(--night);color:white}
.scene--music::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:520px;height:520px;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(152,42,75,.16),transparent 68%);filter:blur(4px)}
.music-card{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:34px;align-items:center;padding:32px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-radius:32px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.record{width:220px;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 50%,#1d1116 0 2px,#2a151d 3px 5px);box-shadow:0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);animation:spin 9s linear infinite}.record.is-paused{animation-play-state:paused}.record::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:70px;height:70px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#a23858,#5f1328);box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #24141a}.record span{position:relative;z-index:2;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;color:#f3cbd6}
.music-card__details h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(44px,8vw,70px);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.04em}.music-card__artist{margin:4px 0 24px;opacity:.62}.track{height:5px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);overflow:hidden}.track span{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:#e59aae}.track-time{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:7px;font-size:9px;opacity:.52}.music-control{margin-top:18px;padding:12px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:white;font-weight:750;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.music-control span{margin-right:7px}

.scene--letter{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7eff0,#fbf6f3)}
.envelope{position:relative;max-width:620px;margin:44px auto 0;padding-top:140px;min-height:430px;perspective:1000px}
.envelope__back{position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;bottom:0;height:315px;border-radius:25px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#e6c3ca,#d5a8b2);box-shadow:0 26px 70px rgba(70,22,38,.12)}
.envelope__front{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:6%;right:6%;bottom:0;height:230px;border-radius:0 0 25px 25px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#edcdd3,#dfb8c1);clip-path:polygon(0 24%,50% 72%,100% 24%,100% 100%,0 100%);pointer-events:none}
.envelope__front::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(36deg,transparent 49.5%,rgba(121,49,69,.08) 50%,transparent 50.5%),linear-gradient(-36deg,transparent 49.5%,rgba(121,49,69,.08) 50%,transparent 50.5%)}
.letter{position:relative;z-index:2;width:82%;margin:0 auto -48px;padding:34px 36px 46px;border:1px solid rgba(117,29,52,.10);border-radius:22px 22px 10px 10px;background:var(--paper);box-shadow:0 20px 55px rgba(66,23,37,.10);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:17px;line-height:1.72;color:#4e323c;transform:translateY(155px);max-height:285px;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,.86,.27,1),max-height .8s ease,margin-bottom .8s ease}
.envelope.is-open .letter{transform:translateY(-80px);max-height:1300px;margin-bottom:20px}
.letter p{margin:0 0 17px}.letter__date{font-size:10px!important;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.17em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--wine-2)}.letter__salute{font-size:27px!important;color:var(--ink)}.letter__highlight{font-size:21px;color:var(--wine);font-style:italic}.letter__signature{font-size:25px;text-align:right;color:var(--wine);margin-bottom:0!important}
.wax-seal{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:50%;bottom:86px;transform:translateX(-50%);display:grid;place-items:center;width:86px;height:86px;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 34% 30%,#c75272,#821d3a 60%,#601226);color:white;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(68,15,32,.23),inset 0 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,.06);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .3s ease,opacity .35s ease}.wax-seal span{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px}.wax-seal small{position:absolute;top:96px;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--wine);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.04em}.envelope.is-open .wax-seal{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(.75);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}

.scene--promise{background:var(--paper)}
.promise{text-align:center}.promise p{margin:0 0 8px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px;color:var(--muted)}.promise strong{display:block;margin:8px 0 25px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(28px,6vw,44px);font-weight:500;color:var(--wine)}.promise h2{margin:28px 0 0;font-size:clamp(50px,10vw,82px);line-height:.93}
.final-unlock{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:min(100%,440px);min-height:74px;margin:42px auto 0;padding:10px 18px 10px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(118,29,52,.18);border-radius:22px;background:white;color:var(--wine);box-shadow:0 17px 45px rgba(63,21,35,.08);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}.final-unlock__fill{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(164,59,89,.12),rgba(164,59,89,.22));pointer-events:none}.final-unlock__heart{position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;place-items:center;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:#f9ebee;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px}.final-unlock>span:last-child{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.final-unlock b{font-size:13px}.final-unlock small{margin-top:3px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}

.finale{position:relative;display:none;min-height:100vh;background:var(--night);color:white;overflow:hidden}.finale.is-unlocked{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(360px,.85fr);align-items:stretch}.finale__visual{min-height:680px;border-radius:0}.finale__copy{position:relative;z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:64px 56px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1c0b12,#2c101b)}.finale__copy h2{margin:0;font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,78px);line-height:.94}.finale__copy h2 em{color:#f0b3c3}.finale__copy>p{max-width:500px;margin:23px 0 20px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;opacity:.78}.finale__copy>strong{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;font-weight:500;color:#f0b3c3}.replay{align-self:flex-start;margin-top:34px;padding:13px 16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:white;font-weight:750;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.floating-hearts{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}.heart-float{position:absolute;bottom:-30px;font-size:var(--size);color:#f0a5ba;opacity:.70;animation:floatHeart var(--dur) ease-in forwards}@keyframes floatHeart{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.7}100%{transform:translateY(-110vh) rotate(28deg);opacity:0}}

.lightbox{width:min(94vw,980px);max-width:none;padding:14px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);border-radius:26px;background:#160b10;color:white;box-shadow:0 30px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.lightbox::backdrop{background:rgba(14,4,8,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.lightbox__close{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:18px;top:17px;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(20,7,12,.70);color:white;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}.lightbox__stage{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:min(72vh,700px);overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;background:#0d080a}.lightbox__stage img{max-width:100%;max-height:min(72vh,700px);object-fit:contain}.lightbox>p{margin:14px auto 8px;max-width:700px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:16px;opacity:.78}.lightbox__controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px}.lightbox__controls button{width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:white;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;cursor:pointer}.lightbox__controls span{font-size:11px;opacity:.62}
.toast{position:fixed;z-index:300;left:50%;bottom:86px;transform:translate(-50%,18px);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(28,10,16,.94);color:white;font-size:11px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

@media(max-width:760px){
  .floating-header{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;}.floating-header__chapter{display:none}.floating-header__progress{justify-content:flex-end}
  .scene{padding:92px 16px}.scene--origin{padding-top:122px}
  .scene-heading--split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}.scene-heading__aside{font-size:17px}
  .memory-entry,.memory-entry--note{grid-template-columns:1fr}.memory-entry__visual{min-height:330px}.memory-entry__symbol{min-height:130px;font-size:42px}.memory-entry__content{padding:28px 24px}
  .album-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}.album-nav{position:absolute;z-index:7;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);background:rgba(255,255,255,.88)}.album-nav:hover{transform:translateY(-50%)}.album-nav--prev{left:8px}.album-nav--next{right:8px}.album-stage{position:relative}.album-photo{border-radius:28px;aspect-ratio:4/5}.album-photo__button{inset:0 0 82px}.album-photo__footer{min-height:82px;padding:13px 14px}.album-photo__footer p{font-size:13px}
  .word-constellation{grid-template-columns:1fr}.word-constellation__message{min-height:120px}.word-constellation>button{min-height:66px}
  .music-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:28px 24px;text-align:center}.record{width:min(60vw,220px);margin:auto}.music-control{width:100%}
  .envelope{padding-top:135px;min-height:450px}.letter{width:88%;padding:30px 25px 40px;font-size:16px}.envelope.is-open .letter{transform:translateY(-70px)}
  .finale.is-unlocked{grid-template-columns:1fr}.finale__visual{min-height:62vh}.finale__copy{padding:45px 24px 80px}.finale__copy h2{font-size:clamp(46px,12vw,66px)}
}
@media(max-width:520px){
  .opening__content{padding:22px 0}.opening-photo{border-radius:26px}.opening h1{font-size:clamp(42px,14vw,61px)}
  .timepiece{padding:19px 14px;border-radius:24px}.timepiece__intro{display:block}.timepiece__intro b{display:block;margin-top:4px}.timepiece__grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px}.timepiece__grid>div{padding:11px 3px}.timepiece__grid strong{font-size:30px}
  .scene-heading h2{font-size:clamp(44px,13vw,62px)}
  .memory-entry{border-radius:27px}.memory-entry__visual{min-height:300px}.memory-entry h3{font-size:34px}
  .album-photo{border-radius:24px}.album-thumb{flex-basis:52px;width:52px;height:52px}
  .audio-dock{right:10px;bottom:10px;max-width:235px}.audio-dock__action{display:none}
  .letter{width:92%;padding:28px 21px 36px}.envelope__back,.envelope__front{left:2%;right:2%}.wax-seal{width:78px;height:78px;bottom:88px}
}
@media(max-width:360px){.scene{padding-left:13px;padding-right:13px}.opening__copy{padding:0 6px}.memory-entry__content{padding:24px 19px}.album-photo__footer{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:2px}.album-photo__footer span{font-size:8px}.word-constellation__message{padding:20px 15px}.final-unlock{grid-template-columns:50px 1fr;padding-right:10px}.final-unlock__heart{width:50px;height:50px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}.audio-dock__disc,.record{animation:none}.heart-float{display:none}}

/* V6.1 — fotografías integradas a la narración sin atribuirles un evento no confirmado */
.story-context{
  max-width:790px;
  margin:28px auto 0;
  padding:18px 22px;
  border:1px solid rgba(118,29,52,.13);
  border-radius:20px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,250,247,.97),rgba(247,232,235,.72));
  color:#6a4b56;
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.72;
  text-align:center;
}
.story-interlude{
  position:relative;
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.72fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:14px;
  align-items:stretch;
  padding:16px;
  border:1px solid rgba(118,29,52,.10);
  border-radius:30px;
  background:linear-gradient(140deg,rgba(255,253,250,.82),rgba(247,235,238,.72));
  overflow:hidden;
}
.story-interlude::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 0 0,rgba(173,85,109,.10),transparent 42%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.story-interlude__copy{
  position:relative;
  z-index:2;
  align-self:center;
  padding:24px 20px;
}
.story-interlude__copy span{
  display:block;
  margin-bottom:8px;
  color:var(--wine-2);
  font-size:9px;
  font-weight:850;
  letter-spacing:.17em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
}
.story-interlude__copy p{
  margin:0;
  max-width:220px;
  font-family:var(--serif);
  font-size:clamp(24px,3.2vw,34px);
  line-height:1.08;
  letter-spacing:-.025em;
  color:#352027;
}
.story-snapshot{
  min-height:290px;
  margin:0;
  border-radius:22px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.72);
}
.story-snapshot img{object-fit:contain}
.story-interlude--reverse .story-interlude__copy{order:3}
.story-interlude--reverse .story-snapshot:nth-of-type(1){order:1}
.story-interlude--reverse .story-snapshot:nth-of-type(2){order:2}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .story-context{margin-top:20px;padding:16px 18px;text-align:left}
  .story-interlude,.story-interlude--reverse{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;padding:10px;border-radius:24px}
  .story-interlude__copy,.story-interlude--reverse .story-interlude__copy{grid-column:1/-1;order:0;padding:14px 10px 8px}
  .story-interlude--reverse .story-snapshot:nth-of-type(1),.story-interlude--reverse .story-snapshot:nth-of-type(2){order:initial}
  .story-interlude__copy p{max-width:none;font-size:27px}
  .story-snapshot{min-height:220px;border-radius:18px}
}
@media(max-width:380px){
  .story-snapshot{min-height:195px}
  .story-interlude__copy p{font-size:24px}
}

</style>
</head>
